blurb:
Experience Atlanta through two powerful lenses—its historic roots and its modern-day rise. This hop on-hop off experience is a 3-hour guided tour that takes you on a journey through the city’s most influential districts tied to the Civil Rights Movement & leaders like Dr. King, Ralph David Abernathy, and Alonzo Herndon. We also present experiences introducing you to the new wave of creative experiences, entrepreneurs, and tastemakers shaping Atlanta today.

 As the tour unfolds, we focus on Atlanta stories that blossomed into million dollar concepts, the music scene, and the thriving food scene that is driving social media crazy and locals crazy. This tour includes Tyler Perry Studios or the famous Outkast mural—perfect for capturing the spirit of the city. More than just sightseeing, this tour creates space for real conversation. Don't miss out on this all inclusive city tour that only Hop'N Go focuses on.
